rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for fine dust on surfaces or in the air.

example.english: The dust at home is really thick, so I need to wipe it first.
example.traditional: 屋企啲灰塵好厚，要抹下先。
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 di1 fui1 can4 hou2 hau5 jiu3 mut3 haa5 sin1

rows.note: Use this for a substance that has been reduced to a fine powder rather than ordinary household dust.

example.english: This medicine has been ground into a fine dust, so you can't take it directly.
example.traditional: 呢啲藥磨成粉末，唔可以直接食。
example.jyutping: nei1 di1 joek6 mo4 sing4 fan2 mut6 m4 ho2 ji5 zik6 zip3 sik6

rows.note: Use this for the household chore of removing dust, especially in expressions such as 做抹塵.

example.english: Today it's my turn to dust.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 leon4 dou3 ngo5 zou6 maat3 can4
